acip: GZHAN YANG, MIG SHES LA SNGON PO'I RNAM PA SHAR BA DE PHYI ROL DON GYIS GTAD PA'I RNAM PA MA YIN TE YIN NA, CHU PHOR GANG LA LAS CAN GYI LHA MI YI DVAGS GSUM GYIS CIG CAR DU BLTAS PA'I TSE,
english: We can also argue it this way: When an image of blue appears to our visual perception, it's not as if some outer object is sending the image to our eyes. Because if it were this way, there's a problem in a situation where three beings with different karma are looking at a single cup filled with a liquid. One of them is a worldly god; one of them is a human being; and one is a craving spirit.
